justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/NullReader.java` (356 lines, 11 methods) and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/NullReaderTest.java`. The class is cohesive: it consistently implements one null-reader abstraction with shared state (`size`, `position`, `mark`, `eof`) and related behaviors only for construction, EOF handling, mark/reset, read, and skip. The protected hooks (`processChar`, `processChars`) are extension points for the same responsibility, not separate concerns, so the class does not show clear evidence of needing decomposition.
